head_commit.message:
feat(docs): implement dark mode toggle and theme customization

- Added a dark mode toggle button to the documentation pages, allowing users to switch between light and dark themes.
- Updated meta tags to support both light and dark color schemes.
- Introduced a new JavaScript file to manage theme preferences and apply the selected theme on page load.
- Created a CSS file for dark theme styles, ensuring consistent appearance across documentation.
- Enhanced documentation pages with theme preview images for both light and dark modes.
- Updated validation scripts to check for the presence of the theme toggle and ensure proper initialization order of scripts.
- Added end-to-end tests to verify theme switching functionality and ensure accessibility compliance.
